meta.name: grill-me
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过高强度提问打磨你的方案或设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在落地前发现计划中的漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Sharpen your plan or design through relentless questioning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to uncover flaws in your plan before execution

howto.what: Claude 会对你提出的计划或设计进行一轮严苛的追问，帮你发现漏洞、完善思路。
howto.when: 当你输入 /grilling 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我 grill 一下这个产品设计方案。
say.note: Claude 会开始追问方案的细节和潜在问题。

say.text: 启动 grilling 会话，我要打磨我的创业计划。
say.note: Claude 会针对计划进行高强度提问。

howto.what_en: Claude will conduct a relentless interview on your plan or design to help sharpen it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type the /grilling command.

say_en.text: Grill this product design for me.
say_en.note: Claude will start questioning the design details and potential issues.

say_en.text: Start a grilling session, I want to refine my startup plan.
say_en.note: Claude will ask tough questions about the plan.
